title: Hall Monitor Signals
description: Contract for /hall-monitor (#2768): what the monitor observes, which findings it can raise, and the guards that bound --auto-create. The monitor is advisory and read-only; nothing here grants it authority to mutate the working tree.

observation.description: What the monitor can see. Broadcast lifecycle announcements plus local git state — never direct messages between two other sessions, which are point-to-point and unobservable.

events.description: The peer-announce.js event vocabulary the monitor consumes.

gitPollFallbackSeconds.description: Long fallback interval for git polling. Bounded to the ScheduleWakeup clamp; short-interval polling for harness-notified work is wasted.

findings.description: The finding kinds the monitor may raise. severity 'filable' plus autoCreatable true is the only combination --auto-create may act on.

enabledByDefault.description: Opt-in only. Unattended filing is the risky half of this command, so the default cannot be true.

label.description: Applied to every auto-filed issue so it is recognisable and reversible.

priorArtRequired.description: A sweep is mandatory before any auto-filed bug. Duplicate filing is a known failure here; an unattended filer has no human check.

onAlreadyShipped.description: An already-shipped verdict skips the filing rather than downgrading it.

autoFile.description: Enhancements are offered, never filed unattended.

mustStayInMonitorSession.description: A delegated subagent has no AskUserQuestion, so it cannot make an offer at all. This is a tool boundary, not a preference.
